title: Check yourself: Which mechanism connects it, what a gateway centralises and whose rights a call uses

blocks.text: Questions on what this page has just taught. Choose one answer for each.

questions.stem: A nightly job always does the same three things in the same order: fetch invoices, ask Claude to label each one, write the labels to a ledger. How should the invoice system be reached?

options.text: As a plain function call made by the code that runs the sequence
options.says: The path is fixed, so the code calls the invoice system and the model is not asked whether to.

options.text: As an MCP server that the model decides to call when it needs invoices
options.says: Ruled out because "Workflows are systems where LLMs and tools are orchestrated through predefined code paths", and a fixed step needs no model decision.

options.text: As a tool in the model's list, left for the model to call when it sees fit
options.says: Ruled out because for a known path "the code calls, so the step is testable", which a tool left to the model's choice is not.

options.text: As a remote agent that the job reaches over an agent-to-agent protocol
options.says: Ruled out because agent-to-agent suits "The counterpart is another agent with its own goals and owner", and an invoice system is not one.

questions.stem: A support agent runs under one service account that may issue refunds, and supervisors legitimately use the same agent for them. A clerk who may only read tickets asks it for a refund, and it is paid. What closes the gap?

options.text: Take the refund tool out of the agent's configuration for every user
options.says: Ruled out because "it also stops the supervisors who are allowed to use it".

options.text: Record each refund so that the clerk's request can be found later
options.says: Ruled out because "A record is written after the refund is paid", so it detects and does not prevent.

options.text: Allow the call only if the asker also holds that scope
options.says: The call is allowed only when the user holds the scope and the agent does too, so the agent's rights are a ceiling.

options.text: Add a line to the system prompt telling clerks not to ask for refunds
options.says: Ruled out because "a line in the system prompt is a request to the model and not a control", and an agent that holds the right can still grant the request.
